entities.name: UniProt Q72U01
observations: Exact 634-aa sequence match to reviewed Leptospira interrogans 1-deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate synthase (DXS).
Catalyzes pyruvate plus glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate condensation to form 1-deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate (DXP).
Annotated to MEP-pathway isopentenyl diphosphate biosynthesis and terpenoid biosynthesis; thiamine biosynthesis also annotated.
GO cellular component: cytosol; annotated TPP and magnesium binding.

entities.name: MEP pathway
observations: DXP synthase catalyzes the first committed entry reaction producing DXP from pyruvate and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate; DXP feeds the MEP isoprenoid pathway.
